actionable_steps.citation: Three Assets That You Must Safeguard — SSS Vol 42 (2009), 2009-07-06
actionable_steps.step: Follow the proper order — concentration, then contemplation, then meditation — and do not mistake the first step for the last.

actionable_steps.citation: Experience Divinity Within In Total Silence — SSS Vol 37 (2004), 2004-11-22
actionable_steps.step: Choose one form, install it in your heart, and contemplate it incessantly with total faith in one name and one form.
Keep contentment in the mind — the royal road to meditation is contentment.
Do not confine meditation to stated hours — make it a continuous process filling your whole personality.
Purify your emotions, clarify your impulses, cultivate love — that mastery is the true process of dhyana.

definition.quote: Meditation means offering the flower of Love to the Divine. The purpose of meditation is to separate the rose of selfless Love from the senses and offer it to the Lord.

discourses.citation: Three Assets That You Must Safeguard — SSS Vol 42 (2009), 2009-07-06
discourses.quote: Real meditation is forgetting oneself totally. It is forgetting the feeling of identification with the body (dehatma bhava) completely. One has to totally give up attachment to the senses.

discourses.citation: Experience Divinity Within In Total Silence — SSS Vol 37 (2004), 2004-11-22
discourses.quote: Choose one form, install it in your heart and see that it is steady. Have total faith in one name and one form and contemplate on it incessantly. That is true meditation.
Meditation should not be confined to a particular time and place. It is a way of life. Whatever is done with the spirit of love is meditation.

discourses.citation: Attain God's Grace Through Sacrifice And Love — SSS Vol 34 (2001), 2001-05-07
discourses.quote: One should go beyond concentration which means the mind should become still. You should be free from thoughts. That is true meditation.

make_it_real: Meditation is not a ten-minute appointment with closed eyes — it is a way of life. Begin from this moment.
title: Meditation (Dhyana)

vahinis.quote: Meditation is the very basis of all spiritual practice (sadhana). Do not give up this royal road that leads you on to that sacred goal.

Therefore, begin meditation, each one of you, from today —even from this moment! Meditation should be performed enthusiastically, with full faith and care, and strictly according to the disciplines laid down.
